description: A black remote control and its battery cover are on the table, and later two AA batteries are visible in the open battery compartment. The right hand picks up the remote (right-hand object), the left hand joins to hold it as a two-hand object, then the left hand slides off the back cover to expose the batteries; the right hand plucks one AA out and sets it on the table, then removes the second battery and brings it out of the compartment while the left hand steadies the remote.
